description: This file defines the DynamoDbClient class, a PHP client for interacting with Amazon DynamoDB via the AWS SDK. It includes method signatures for various DynamoDB operations, session handler registration, and internal configuration methods.

classes.name: Aws\DynamoDb\DynamoDbClient
classes.description: Client class for communicating with the Amazon DynamoDB service. Extends AwsClient and provides methods for DynamoDB operations, session handling, and internal configuration.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the default argument configuration for the DynamoDbClient, including retries and API provider settings.

methods.name: registerSessionHandler
methods.description: Creates and registers a session handler instance that uses this DynamoDB client.

methods.name: _applyRetryConfig
methods.description: Internal method to apply retry configuration to the handler list, supporting legacy and v2 modes.

methods.name: _applyApiProvider
methods.description: Internal method to apply an API provider to the client configuration and wrap the parser with CRC32 validation.
